standard_prerequisites.name: The set of elements satisfying the p-power conditions
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Introduced in the counted proof at lines 11101-11104
standard_prerequisites.use: Isolates the elements whose images in residue fields are controlled, which is the set shown to be everything.

standard_prerequisites.name: Local nilpotence of the kernel
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used at the start of the counted proof (lines 11100-11101)
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows elements of the kernel to be discarded, which is what keeps the generated set closed under the operations.

core_obligations: Show that the set of elements satisfying both p-power conditions is closed under sums, products and scalars and contains the images of the base, using local nilpotence of the kernel to discard kernel elements (proof lines 11099-11123).

Conclude that every element of the target lies in that set, which gives the homeomorphism statement and the residue field condition, and check that the two hypotheses are preserved by base change (proof lines 11123-11126).
proof_roadmap: Prove the set of good elements is all of the target (proof lines 11099-11123).
Read off the topological and residue field conclusions (proof lines 11123-11127).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a ring map generated by elements satisfying the p-power and p-multiple conditions, with locally nilpotent kernel, induces a homeomorphism on spectra with controlled residue field extensions, and that these hypotheses are stable under base change (statement lines 11084-11097). The proof isolates the set of elements satisfying the two conditions, shows it is closed under the ring operations and contains the images of the base by discarding kernel elements through local nilpotence, and then reads the conclusions off that the set is everything (proof lines 11099-11127). Proving closure of that set under the operations is the step that carries the argument. H2.
